description: Source code for a Kubernetes DRA (Dynamic Resource Allocation) plugin, implementing gRPC server interfaces for resource claim preparation, unpreparation, and error handling, with support for resource slicing and registration services.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: Main struct managing gRPC servers, registration, resource publishing, and plugin lifecycle.

classes.name: nodePluginImplementation
classes.description: Wrapper implementing gRPC server interfaces for node resource preparation and unpreparation.

methods.name: NodePrepareResources
methods.description: Handles gRPC call to prepare resource claims, serializing if enabled, and returns device info.

methods.name: NodeUnprepareResources
methods.description: Handles gRPC call to unprepare resource claims, serializing if enabled, and reports errors.

methods.name: getResourceClaims
methods.description: Retrieves ResourceClaim objects from Kubernetes API based on claims in request.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops all background goroutines and cleans up resources.

methods.name: PublishResources
methods.description: Publishes resource information via ResourceSlice objects.

methods.name: RegistrationStatus
methods.description: Returns registration status of the plugin.

methods.name: SetGetInfoError
methods.description: Configures GetInfo call to return a specific error.

methods.name: SetNotifyRegistrationStatusError
methods.description: Configures NotifyRegistrationStatus call to return a specific error.
